verdict.rationale: Pendo documents first-party session replay that shows what users did click by click. It also documents on-device masking with three no-code privacy levels (Maximum Privacy, Inputs Only, Minimum Privacy), so sensitive input can be masked before data reaches Pendo. The evidence does not say which level is the default, so the 'masked by default' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation that sensitive input masking is on by default, independent or hands-on corroboration of replay and masking behavior.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Watch what users did click by click, with frustration signals like rage clicks and U-turns flagged automatically.
Masking runs on the device before data is sent to Pendo. Choose Maximum Privacy, Inputs Only, or Minimum Privacy, all no-code.
Click a funnel drop-off, an NPS detractor, or a piece of feedback and watch the sessions behind it.
